principle: Low effort in front. High rigour behind.

patternRules.rule: Colour = meaning for pills: stage (StatusChip tone from STATUS_TONE_MAP), flag (FlagPill), urgency (UrgencyPill, the only solid colour pills), who has it (WhoPill, outline), facts (TagPill, outline). Navy fill means In progress only.
patternRules.enforcedBy: check:patterns (live tone rows, outline WhoPill, token-only colours)

patternRules.rule: Record pages lead with the problem or subject as the heading, never a label such as 'The job'; pills above, facts as a labelled grid below.
Notes are quotes with author and time; facts are a labelled grid (label small, value large in ink).
Times are readable: label, value in ink at body size, plain helper line. Never a faint grey timestamp or an empty value.
Histories are day-grouped timelines, newest first: who did what, clock time, stage pill, note; older entries fold behind 'Show n earlier'.
Long lists are never endless: 10 rows a page (50 at most), search, filter chips with counts, sortable headers, actions such as Download in the toolbar, two-line rows on a phone.
patternRules.enforcedBy: check:patterns (paging) and check:consumer (Ledger pageSize above maxListPageSize)

patternRules.rule: Home carousels never repeat what a card below already shows.
One next action per card. A card's single button is the next step for its record; anything else is a quiet link or lives in the record's Actions menu.
A date range shows where today sits: start and end dates, the part gone, a today marker, the days left.
